description: This file contains utilities for integrating with Large Language Models (LLMs) to correct or upgrade subtitle cues based on transcript context. It includes prompt construction, environment-based client selection for OpenAI or stub clients, and functions for processing single or multiple cues with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented-Generation).

classes.name: LLMPromptContext
classes.description: Data class that holds information necessary to build prompts for LLM correction of subtitle cues.

classes.name: LLMClientError
classes.description: Custom exception raised for errors related to LLM client misconfiguration or failures.

methods.name: str _format_time(seconds: float)
methods.description: Formats seconds into a human-readable H:MM:SS.mmm string.

methods.name: str build_cue_prompt(ctx: LLMPromptContext)
methods.description: Constructs the prompt string sent to the LLM for correcting a subtitle cue, including transcript context and cue timing.

methods.name: Any _get_llm_client()
methods.description: Returns an LLM client instance, either real (OpenAI) or stub, based on environment variables.

methods.name: str _clean_llm_text(s: str)
methods.description: Normalizes the output text from the LLM by removing fences, quotes, and collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] _retry_with_backoff(callable_fn, max_retries: int = 2, base_delay: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Executes a callable with retry logic and exponential backoff on failure.

methods.name: str correct_cue_with_rag(cue_text: str, start: float, end: float, topk_segments: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Public API to correct a single subtitle cue using top-k transcript segments via LLM.

methods.name: List[str] batch_correct_cues_with_rag( cues: List[Dict[str, Any]], rag_results: List[List[Dict[str, Any]]], )
methods.description: Public API to batch-correct multiple cues with corresponding transcript segments, utilizing retries and optional concurrency controls.
